source_row.rationale: Testicular self-examination education encourages young adult males to become familiar with the normal size, shape, and consistency of their testicles, so they can more readily notice and promptly report any new lump, swelling, or other change to a healthcare provider for further evaluation, supporting early detection given that testicular cancer often presents in younger men and is highly treatable when caught early.
